sentences.text: In the meantime, the operation of the order dated Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.37935 of 2023(2) dt.10-01-2024 14.10.2022 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Begusarai in Complaint Case No. 530(C-1) of 2022 whereby cognizacne of the offence under Sections 323 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code has been taken, shall remain stayed.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners are the officials of the IOCL and some lands were to be acquired for the purpose of laying pipelines.
The opposite party no. 2 being the land owner was objecting and thus instituted the present false case.

It is further submitted that the Government of India vide Gazette Notification dated 09.08.2017 and 26.04.2018 issued under the provision of the Petrolium and Mineral Pipeline (Acquisition of Right of User in Land) Act, 1962 has declared the land in question along with others for acquisition.

sentences.text: It is next submitted that the authorities are ready to pay compensation of the land of the opposite party no. 2 which has been acquired but then the opposite party no. 2 is not coming forward for receiving the compensation and thus has instituted the present false complaint case in order to coerce the employees of the company into submission.
